subject: Reframe intro demo into two-day POC planning workshop — reschedule options

Subject: Reframe intro demo into two-day POC planning workshop — initial ask

Hi Priya / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. After internal sync, our product and infra leads would prefer a two-day POC planning workshop (deep dive + hands-on scoping) instead of the 45-minute overview you proposed. The goal is to leave with a mutual action plan and a list of deliverables for an eval.

A few constraints from our side:
- Our CTO (Carlos) is traveling the week of May 5–9 and can only attend either May 6–7 as remote or the week after in person.
- We have teams in US (PST) and EU (CEST) who need overlapping hours.
- Procurement is asking for a rough timeline by end of April.

Can Redwood help convert the session format and propose a couple of date/time options? Also, can you share a sample agenda and attendee list we'd need? I'm copying Sean for the success/ops alignment.

Attachments: EdgeScale-internal-constraints.pdf (summary)

—Maria

Subject: Re: Reframe intro demo into two-day POC planning workshop — initial ask

Hi Maria — thanks for the context and the constraints doc. Totally doable to convert to a two-day POC planning workshop. Quick thoughts / ask:

1) Dates: I am traveling the week of Apr 21 and have limited availability the week after. Tentatively we can run:
   - Option A: May 6–7 (remote, half-days to accommodate EU overlap)
   - Option B: May 12–13 (preferred if Carlos can join in person one of the days)

2) Attendees we recommend from EdgeScale: CTO (Carlos), Product lead, Infra/DevOps lead, one engineering IC who owns deployment. From Redwood: Marissa (AE), Rishi (SE), myself (solutions). Sean will join for success/ops.

3) Sample agenda / deliverables: I attached a short POC-outline (POC-outline-v1.pdf) and dropped a calendar invite template (proposed-agenda.ics). We usually run:
   Day 1 — Architecture & integration scoping (tech deep dive, infra constraints, data flow)
   Day 2 — Success criteria & mutual action plan (milestones, test prompts, evaluation data, roles)

4) Prework: a small dataset sample + an architecture diagram are ideal. Rishi can detail exactly what we need if you confirm.

If May 12–13 looks good, we can lock it and I’ll send updated invites with timezone-friendly slots. If May 6–7 is easier for you, we can compress to split mornings (US) / afternoons (EU).

Thanks — talk soon.

—Priya

Thanks Priya — appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple of notes:

- Carlos is definitely unavailable May 6–7 (he's traveling that week and can't join remote sessions earlier than 11am PST).
- May 12–13 works better for leadership. We do need to split some content because EU colleagues are only available in the morning CEST. Could you do Day 1 as a cross-team sync (overlap hours) and Day 2 as two parallel tracks (infra + product) with recordings?
- Procurement wants a high-level timeline and expected resource commitment by 4/25 — can Redwood provide a one-page timeline?

Sean — can you confirm success/ops availability on May 12–13 and whether Redwood can share an intake form for our infra details?

If May 12–13 is good from your side, we'll lock it and circulate attendee confirmations.

—Maria

Hi Maria — quick technical note and proposed slots (converting to PST/CEST):

Prework we need (light):
- Short dataset sample (s3 link or CSV) and a representative prompt set
- High-level infra diagram (network, where inference will run, VPC details if any)
- Any compliance constraints (data residency, logging)

Slot proposals (all times below show PST then CEST):
- Proposal 1 (preferred):
  Day 1: May 12 — 10:00–13:00 PST / 19:00–22:00 CEST (cross-team overlap block)
  Day 2: May 13 — 09:00–12:00 PST (Infra track) & 14:00–17:00 PST (Product track; overlap with EU morning)

- Proposal 2 (split mornings):
  Day 1: May 12 — 08:00–11:00 PST / 17:00–20:00 CEST
  Day 2: May 13 — two half-day windows to accommodate local teams (we can run infra in PST morning, product in EU morning)

I attached a short prework checklist and a draft intake form link for your engineering team to fill out. If those slots won't work, tell me your constraints and we can refine.

Attachments: prework-checklist.pdf, intake-form-link.txt
